sentences.text: 2.  The case of the petitioner is that an award was made under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 on 3.9.2022 in respect of various lands acquired by the notification dated 6.07.2022 under Section 19 of the Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Gata No.69, which belongs to the petitioner, was also subject matter of the award.
The petitioner has filed an application on 3.02.2022 before Collector, Shahjahanpur for making a reference to the Authority under Section 64 of the Act for enhancement of compensation.
It was followed by a reminder on 4.01.2023, but the Collector has not passed any order.
